title: Creative headlines
slide_intent: Teach designers to direct the order of reading as words overlap or change size. Type can convey the action of a sentence through its arrangement.
strategic_value: Frontline AIDS can echo the layering of activist placards while giving a particular message a distinct visual rhythm.
demonstration: The question is assembled from black uppercase words on separate pink blocks against cyan. The blocks overlap and increase in scale toward the large final word and question mark.
practical_value: Read an experimental headline aloud in the order its layout suggests. Adjust layering and scale until the sentence still resolves.

content_islands.name: Construction prompts
content_islands.spec: Arrange Context, Back to front, Readability and Scale as short instructions beside the section rail.

content_islands.name: Headline composition
content_islands.spec: Fill the right half with cyan and stack separate pink text blocks over it. Overlap selected lines, enlarge the last word and separate the question mark below it.

content_islands.name: Font note
content_islands.spec: Place the small note beneath the composition so the example remains the dominant visual.
